# PhoenixFormAwesomplete v1.0.2 - Table of Contents

Phoenix component that utilizes Lea Verou's autocomplete autosuggest accessible (WCAG 2) Awesomplete widget, featuring dynamic data loading

## Modules

- [PhoenixFormAwesomplete](https://phoenix-form-awesomplete.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixFormAwesomplete.md): 
PhoenixFormAwesomplete is a [Phoenix function component](https://hexdocs.pm/phoenix_live_view/Phoenix.Component.html)
that utilizes Lea Verou's autocomplete / autosuggest / typeahead /
inputsearch [Awesomplete widget](https://leaverou.github.io/awesomplete/index.html), 
complying to accessibility standards (WCAG 2, Section 508).
- [PhoenixFormAwesomplete.EmbedScriptComponent](https://phoenix-form-awesomplete.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixFormAwesomplete.EmbedScriptComponent.md): Provides function components for the Awesomplete script generator component,
to embed autocomplete functionality in the HTML pages.
Can only be used outside LiveView.

- [PhoenixFormAwesomplete.GenJS](https://phoenix-form-awesomplete.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixFormAwesomplete.GenJS.md): 
Generate the javascript code for PhoenixFormAwesomplete.
- [PhoenixFormAwesomplete.HookComponent](https://phoenix-form-awesomplete.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixFormAwesomplete.HookComponent.md): Provides function components for the Awesomplete component,
for autocomplete functionality.
Uses a hook for the javascript code.
Usable inside and outside LiveView.
